system.description: You turned your back on your former organization and now stand with another, perhaps a Camarilla turncoat, a Sabbat refugee or an independent who joined a greater sect. As long as you have this Flaw you are suspect within your new sect: you may hold Status normally, but elders treat you as though you had only one Status Trait, and even your associates may be judged tainted.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
